label: GO WITH CONDITIONS
call: Option C, lekin apne cash se: abhi ₹8 crore mat lo, debt mat lo. ₹15 lakh ka 60-din metro quick commerce test chalao, 6 January 2027 ko band karo, phir data ke saath VC ke paas jao.

why.point: Metro quick commerce pe data zero hai; 25 se 35% commission aur 8% margin pe pehle retention aur per-order contribution ka number chahiye.
₹40 crore ek term sheet pe lagbhag 100x earnings hai; plan miss hua toh down round aur anti-dilution.
Debt bilkul nahi: ₹2.5 crore at 15% ka interest poora ₹37.5 lakh profit kha jaata hai.
Jawab ₹15 lakh mein mil sakta hai, toh ₹8 crore pe 20% dena bina wajah ka risk hai.
why.framework: Return of capital before return on capital

minority.quote: Kotak ka worst case P&L pe bach jaata hai, cap table pe nahi.
minority.would_have_to_be_true: Founder ke liye ₹8 se 9 crore pe profitable aur debt-free rehna 3 saal ke ₹15 crore target se zyada maayne rakhta ho.

next_steps.action: VC se 60 din ka hold maango aur family ko loan ka likhit schedule do (₹2.8 lakh per month, January 2027 se).
Top 5 SKUs ka quick commerce unit economics likho, phir 15 dark stores aur top Tier-2 city mein listing live karo.
Test band, numbers dekho: pass toh 2 term sheets ke saath raise, fail toh B.

kill_criteria: Week-six repeat 10% se neeche, per-order contribution negative, ya bank ₹25 lakh se neeche: test band, VC ko no, B pe wapas.
conditions: Bank mein kabhi ₹25 lakh se kam nahi
Family loan schedule is hafte, January 2027 se ₹2.8 lakh per month
Raise sirf 25%+ repeat, positive contribution, 2 term sheets, 1x non-participating aur family loan mein VC ka paisa zero ke saath

fights.crux: Metro test ka paisa: debt, equity, ya apna cash?
fights.story: Mittal debt, Kotak equity, Kamath aur Aadit apna cash. Kotak ke interest math ne Mittal ko hataya, Aadit ke chhote test aur Mittal ke family-loan point ne Kotak ko hataya. Chaaron apne cash pe aaye.
Kamath aur Mittal ne trap kaha. Kotak ne pehle ring-fence ke saath haan kaha, phir family loan wala flaw maana. Aaj trap, data ke baad mauka ho sakta hai.
Kotak aur Mittal pehle abhi decide karna chahte the; Round 2 mein Mittal, Kotak aur Aadit ne kaha VC 60 din ruk nahi sakta toh jaane do.

cheapest_test: ₹15 lakh, 60 din, 15 dark stores plus top Tier-2 city; week-six repeat aur per-order contribution track karo.
revisit: 6 January 2027: repeat rate, per-order contribution, cash balance, aur term sheets ki ginti ke saath.
override_note: Quick mode: Round 3 skip, kyunki C pe spread 1 tha aur kisi seat pe ruin risk likely nahi.
